seed: One regular origin tetrahedron, with the inherited ordered C0,M0,C1,M1 marking; translation and alternate seed frames are not silently identified or enumerated.
boundaries: Entry is the seed P-window's first C0; each E packet supplies a marked C-exit at its last window occurrence C_(origin+2). This is a declared boundary convention, not a derived physical interface.
carrier: Five symbolic complex root coefficients; retain every slot, absolute realization origin, geometric chart and complete construction word.
geometry: Generate unique neighboring primitives locally using lattice-items.mjs; no preassembled finite lattice or isotope geometry is input.
operationCost: One per operation occurrence, including re-reading and transfers to an already present packet. Each operation introduces at most one new primitive body.
branching: Apply every compatible operation from every retained construction packet; electron packets have no outgoing operation, but do not stop other assembly branches.
outsideContext: Use the existing full-five-slot reference law. Native P anchors for N charts are derived from actual local geometry even when that reference P is not occupied. This is frame provenance, not an inserted proton.
compatibility: Global named C/M roles agree on every retained geometric mark, including complementary reference marks
P bodies are regular primitives and N bodies have native regular-P reference geometry; E can occupy either primitive kind if the common NE window admits it
No P/E, E/E or P/P full-face contact
PN contacts are MCM; NN and NE contacts are MCC
pendingContacts: Record structurally permitted but not yet witnessed full-face contacts rather than silently treating adjacency as transport.
exitAcceptance: At least one E exit, every physical face contact witnessed by a local full-packet operation, and every retained packet able to reach an E in the generated available-packet graph.
historyRepresentation: Canonical configuration nodes retain the full set of construction packets. Complete ordered operation words remain distinct graph paths. Node reuse is justified only because future rules depend on that full packet set; no quotient of word histories is asserted.
isotopeInterpretation: Composition labels are assigned after enumeration and are not evidence of physical binding or stability.
completion: Claim exhaustion only if the entire nine-operation configuration frontier completes. A resource stop must report complete=false and cannot pass the nine-operation completeness gate.
